title: FormBench: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Retrieval in Formulation Patents
abstract: arXiv:2610.30175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce FormBench, a platform for testing the ability of models to retrieve precise chemical information from technical documents. FormBench contains 55,352 queries and two retrieval corpus variants each with ~1M passages: FormBench-Random (C0), with randomly sampled distractors, and FormBench-Structured (C1), with structurally proximate distractors. Each query is paired with an anchor passage, a hard negative, and a soft negative - derived from a materials ontology through entity overlap scoring, providing a deeper graded signal on a model's discriminatory power. We evaluate 10 model configurations spanning commercial API encoders (OpenAI, Voyage), open-source encoders (Nomic, GTE-large, Qwen3-Embed), and their task-adaptive fine-tuned (TAPT) variants. We find: (1) commercial APIs score very poorly across all configurations (OpenAI-3-large: 0.009 on C1, 0.213 on C0); (2) TAPT on FormBench triplets lifts Qwen3-Embed to 0.4085 on C1,

translated_title: FormBench：面向配方专利细粒度检索的基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了FormBench，一个用于测试模型从技术文档中检索精确化学信息能力的平台。FormBench包含55,352个查询和两个检索语料库变体，每个变体约有100万个段落：FormBench-Random（C0）使用随机采样的干扰项，FormBench-Structured（C1）使用结构上相近的干扰项。每个查询都配有一个锚定段落、一个硬负例和一个软负例——这些通过材料本体中的实体重叠评分构建，为模型的判别能力提供了更深层次的分级信号。我们评估了10种模型配置，涵盖商业API编码器（OpenAI、Voyage）、开源编码器（Nomic、GTE-large、Qwen3-Embed）及其任务自适应微调（TAPT）变体。我们发现：(1) 商业API在所有配置上表现都很差（OpenAI-3-large在C1上仅为0.009，在C0上为0.213）；(2) 在FormBench三元组上进行TAPT使Qwen3-Embed在C1上的性能提升至0.4085。
tldr: 该论文提出了FormBench基准，用于评估模型从配方专利等技术文档中检索精确化学信息的能力，发现商业API编码器表现极差，而基于FormBench三元组进行任务自适应微调的开源编码器性能显著提升。
en_tdlr: FormBench is a benchmark for evaluating models' fine-grained retrieval of precise chemical information from formulation patents, revealing that commercial API encoders perform poorly while task-adaptive fine-tuned open-source encoders achieve substantially better results.
